notes.title: PC Hotfix (04.09.2019)
notes.content:
Hey again, Stalkers!

A new hotfix has rolled out for the Steam version of Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden. This update will be rolled out to the other stores at a later point.

Patch notes are listed below:

---

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[b]Critical Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix for chest opening crash experienced by some users.
[*] Fixed crashes that can occur with fungus spores and fire.
[*] Fixed potential softlock when hiding all three crew members.
[*] Numbers now appear correctly for machines with Arabic regional settings.
[*] Fixed rare throw crash.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] "Tough Nut" Achievement is unlocked by finishing Iron Mutant Mode in any difficulty.
[*] Bot is now force started if less than 2 enemies alive in the barn squad. This is to allow the pickup of the "El Generator" artifact.
[*] Fixed erroneous savegame prompt when pausing during cutscenes.
[*] Fixed some super rare crashes related to mouse control.
[/list]

notes.title: Mutant Year Zero Patch Notes ( 14.08.2019 )
notes.content:
Hello Stalkers!

A new patch and a posterior hotfix are live for Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden and its Seeds of Evil expansion, you may find the patch notes below:

[h1][u]CRITICAL FIXES[/u][/h1]

[list]
[*] Fix for Treehugger crash.
[*] Fix for Ground Pound crash.
[*] Fix for crash when maxing out save slots in 3 or more sessions.
[*] Failsafe for potential crash when AI is moving.
[*] Fixed rare crash when travelling to the Under-Ark.

[*] Fix for “characters falling from the second floor makes them land below ground rendering affected enemies untargetable”.
[/list]

[*] Fix for difficulty selection bug when overwriting savegames.

[*] Control pad/keyboard selection bug fixed.
[*] Fix for Big Khan being able to damage himself with his own flame puke attack and the attack not hitting the full grid.
[*] Joker ability no longer taunts all enemies in the map, plus some other fixes with this.
[*] Fix for rare bug that makes the GUI vanish.
[*] Pyro’s damage VS preview is now consistant.
[*] Fix for ‘Doctor’ Artifact skill not granting the amount of health bonus as shown.
[*] Fix for Artifact skill costs in Pripp’s Bar.
[*] Fix for med-bots revive action not being interrupted under certain conditions.
[*] Fix for Magnus’ Puppeteer not being interrupted under certain conditions.
[*] Fix for infinite medkit pickup glitch on Sea Titans map.
[*] Credits music now loops.
[*] Lots more stability and minor level fixes.
[*] Minor localization fixes.
[/list]

Thank you for all the issues reported and feedback shared so far!

notes.title: Now Available - Seed of Evil Expansion
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/29f3c728d6d1e46187d8232b8861b6c00bc01bf2.jpg[/img]

We have officially launched the first expansion to the tactical adventure game Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden! This expansion, titled Seed of Evil, continues where the original story left off in the adventures of mutant Stalkers Dux, Bormin, Selma, Magnus and Farrow. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1088000/Mutant_Year_Zero_Seed_of_Evil/

After the end of Road to Eden, a new threat arises. Gigantic crimson vines are wrapping around the scaffolding and ramshackle buildings of the Zone’s last safe haven. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/0117988e6e6fa843acf490b95064027d49532ea1.jpg[/img]

Bormin once again takes his team into the irradiated Zone to find and eliminate the source of the threat, but this time he’s got some extra help: The veteran Stalker Big Khan.

https://youtu.be/opZUixv0UPw

[h1]4 new features in Mutant Year Zero: Seed of Evil[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]More content:[/b] Seed of Evil takes place in an entirely new area of the Zone. Explore new maps and defeat the new plant based Pod Ghouls, who will attack you with mutations of their own. As you explore you’ll also find new weapons and armor, which will be of great help to you.  
[*][b]A new Stalker enters the fray:[/b] Big Khan the moose is a legendary Stalker who left the Ark years ago for unknown reasons. He teams up with Bormin, Dux, and the rest of the team to fight the new threat and keep the Ark safe. Khan’s size and strength make him an excellent fighter, capable of landing highly damaging critical hits against enemies. 
[*][b]New mutations:[/b] We’re introducing a brand new mechanic in Seed of Evil that lets you upgrade certain existing mutations. Bormin’s Hug Rosh can become a mighty Bear Smash, with increased power, while Selma’s Tree Hugger can become a Tree Caster ability, which can temporarily turn enemies into cover for you to hide behind. 
[*][b]Retake lost territory:[/b] Zone Ghouls, bots and other horrors are encroaching on places you’ve already cleared out in Road to Eden. This time around they’re stronger than ever and your Stalkers are tasked by the Ark with clearing them out. 
[/list]

Good luck out there, Stalkers!

Zone Ghouls, bots and other horrors are encroaching on places you’ve already cleared out in Road to Eden. This time around they’re stronger than ever and your Stalkers are tasked by the Ark with clearing them out.

notes.title: Seed of Evil, the new Mutant Year Zero Expansion, Revealed!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/29f3c728d6d1e46187d8232b8861b6c00bc01bf2.jpg[/img]

We’re excited to reveal the new expansion to [i]Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden[/i]. It’s called [i]Seed of Evil[/i] and it will expand the original game in multiple ways.  

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f3dcfchKuKA

The expansion picks up where the original game ended and offers hours of more gameplay, new locations to visit, expanded gameplay options, and a new Mutant to add to your party: Big Khan, the moose. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1088000/Mutant_Year_Zero_Seed_of_Evil/

When a mysterious enemy with the power to control plants threatens the Ark, the Stalkers must use their fighting skills to defeat the enemy's minions, discover the enemy's true identity, and save the Ark.

[i]We highly recommend that you finish the main story in[/i] Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden [i]before playing[/i] Seed of Evil[i], due to story spoilers and the level range of the new content.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/0117988e6e6fa843acf490b95064027d49532ea1.jpg[/img]

[h1]New features and Content [/h1]
[i]Seed of Evil[/i] brings a wide breadth of new content to [i]Mutant Year Zero[/i]. Discover huge new maps, battle new enemies, improve your mutations, equip new gear, and face off against a vicious new adversary. 

[h1]Continue the main story [/h1]
See what happens after the ending of [i]Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden[/i]. The lives of Bormin, Dux, Pripp and the others at the Ark continue. New events are unfolding as the weight of their new knowledge weigh down on them, and a new enemy appears from the shadows of the Zone. 

[h1]Meet Big Khan, a brand-new playable Mutant [/h1]
Buying the [i]Seed of Evil[/i] expansion lets you add an entirely new Mutant to the team: Big Khan the moose. He is a veteran Stalker who has been exploring the Zone on his own in self-imposed exile. His size and strength make him an excellent fighter, capable of landing highly damaging critical hits against enemies. His unique mutations are [b]Ground Pound[/b] and [b]Flame Puke[/b], attacks that make him effective at dealing with groups of enemies. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/abf3cec8d8c67a3790e17a3d1e46a266fde76883.jpg[/img]

[h1]A new threat rises [/h1]
The Ark has become enveloped in mysterious roots, and many of its inhabitants seem different from their normal selves. Even the Zone Ghouls seem to have changed. This new menace threatens not only the Ark, but the entire Zone, and it’s up to your team of Stalkers to set things right!  

The new storyline in [i]Seed of Evil[/i] offers new challenges in brand new maps. You will visit the Hall of Electric Coffins and the Mausoleum of Suburbia, to name a few. These areas are populated with new enemies, forcing you to rethink your regular tactics. 

[h1]Improve your mutations [/h1]
We’re introducing a brand-new mechanic in [i]Seed of Evil[/i] that will allow you to upgrade and improve your mutations. Upgrade Bormin’s [b]Hog Rush[/b] to a [b]Bear Smash[/b] for increased power, or change [b]Corpse Eater[/b] to [b]Corpse Feaster[/b], so recovering HP no longer costs an Action Point. Dux’ [b]Moth Wings[/b] can be upgraded to [b]Wings of the Sniper[/b], which removes all range penalties from shots when flying. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/29fe68b6fcae5b98e638c9dbec07610475718372.jpg[/img]

[h1]Retake lost territory [/h1]
Zone Ghouls and Polis Bots are once again encroaching on places like the [b]Spear of Heaven[/b] or the [b]Sea Titans[/b]. This time they’re stronger than ever and your Stalker team is tasked with clearing them out. Beware, though, the enemies are stronger than before! 

[h1]New release date [/h1]
We have decided to move the release date for [i]Seed of Evil[/i] and the retail Deluxe Edition of [i]Road to Eden[/i] a month. The new release date for [i]Mutant year Zero: Seed of Evil[/i], and the retail Deluxe Edition, is July 30th. 

We know you’re very excited about the expansion, so are we, and we can’t wait to see what you think!

notes.title: Stalker Trials Out Now on PC
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/a01fe14a49bd02cd388a02f6ed5c5810841b74b0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Welcome Stalkers, to your new testing grounds![/h1]

Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden is expanding with the release of Stalker Trials. This separate challenge mode rolls out in a free update and will truly put your skills as a Mutant Stalker to the test.

All you need to do to access this new content is to patch the game to the latest version. Then you'll find the Stalker Trials in the main menu.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/97c8610063b40ca0ea126541f5f87173b64f3e2d.jpg[/img]

The game’s maps will be re-populated with different types of enemies to create new challenges for you and your chosen team. All characters, mutations and skills will be available at your fingertips, but you need to buy and upgrade any weapons and armor you think you’ll need.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/f721a3ce3fa9290c9fd0700f13872562d129168e.jpg[/img]

Out in the Zone, Pripp the bartender will be waiting for you. He’s the brains behind the Stalker Trials, having set up the series of challenges for Dux, Bormin and the rest. As you fight your way through an area, Pripp will score you on your progress and performance, and you’ll be rewarded with extra points and multipliers by performing certain actions, like not taking damage, or killing an enemy with an Overwatch attack.

Your progress will be registered on leaderboards, and the weekly and all-time top players will have an NPC named after them for other players to take down.

Keep watching this space, as there is more to come down the line. We’re not quite ready to talk about it just yet, but we think you’ll like what we’ve got in the pipeline.

----------------

Additionally, we're also adding in some quick fixes and quality of life updates:

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[b]STALKER TRIALS ARE NOW AVAILABLE[/b] 
[list]
[*] A series of challenging map remixes with leaderboards
[list]
[*] Compete worldwide to see who is officially the best stalker.
[/list]
[*] Added dialogue for chest opening.
[*] Additional options
[list]
[*] Mouse sensitivity slider
[*] Subtitle size slider
[*] Motion blur slider
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Major Changes/Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Crash fix when returning to the dirty old man after finding his stashes.
[*] Fixed all reported instances of crew getting stuck in levels.
[*] Crash fix for rare chain lightning issue.
[*] Improved mouse focus for multi-screen setups.
[/list]

[b]Medium Changes/Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue that made it impossible to throw grenades from the inside to the outside of train carts
[*] Fixed issue where killing with a mind-controlled unit could cause the next unit to loose its turn
[*] Melee attacks with possessed units now always cause the same damage as they would have being on the other team.
[*] Fixed issue that allowed Tank Ghouls to charge cloaked units
[*] Fixed issue where player would lose an action point when being caught sneaking
[*] Fixed issue with molotovs thrown onto train roofs
[*] Fixed issue that would cause Zone Dogs to be stuck in midair when knocked off certain buildings.
[*] Fixed reported instances of enemies shooting through walls
[/list]

[b]Minor Changes/Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Skull countdown icons removed from character portraits. Didn’t really work well and added clutter.
[*] 25% Penalty removed from kneeshot
[*] Melee health bars are now working correctly
[*] Achievement fixes
[*] DRM is disabled
[*] Many other small fixes and tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: Stalker Trials Coming to PC February 26
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/a01fe14a49bd02cd388a02f6ed5c5810841b74b0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Greetings mutants and stalkers! [/h1]

Today we are incredibly excited to announce that Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden is expanding with the addition of Stalker Trials, a challenge mode that will truly put your skills to the test. We’re re-populating the game’s maps with different types of enemies to create new challenges for you and your chosen team of stalkers. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/de356267f0b21170458287624de40cc208104746.jpg[/img]

We’ll be rolling out the Stalker Trials on PC in a free update next week, on February 26th, so mark your calendars and get ready to gear up! Consoles will get this update at a later date.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/a8525b055fb429d77085129d83d7a43033f23d0a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Sneak and fight to impress Pripp [/h1]

The Stalker Trials give you access to all characters, with all mutations and skills unlocked, but you will have to buy and upgrade your weapons and armor before heading out. Once you’re satisfied with your loadout you can journey into the Zone and link up with Pripp, the bartender. He’s the brains behind the Stalker Trials, and will score you on your progress as you fight your way through an area. Your rewards will be new items and equipment that you can either use on a new map, or sett at Iridia’s shop. 

Your progress will be noted down on the in-game leaderboards and the weekly and all-time top Stalker will have an NPC named after them for other players to take down. Pripp will also reward you with extra points if you clear a map in certain ways, for example by not taking damage or not using explosives. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/f721a3ce3fa9290c9fd0700f13872562d129168e.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/97c8610063b40ca0ea126541f5f87173b64f3e2d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Watch this space [/h1]

It’s been a fantastic two months since the launch on Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden in December, 2018. We’ve been following your tweets, forum and Reddit posts, YouTube videos and Twitch streams and it’s been an absolute blast to see what you’ve thought about the game. 

During the time since launch we’ve been working on fixing bugs and issues with the game. Several of those fixes will come out alongside the Stalker Trials, on February 26. We will also continue to roll out additional patches as needed. 

Keep watching this space. We’ve got even more stuff coming down the line, but we’re not quite ready to talk about that just yet.

notes.title: MYZ Critical Bug Fixes (19.12.2018)
notes.content:
Good afternoon, Stalkers!

We have rolled out another patch for the PC version of Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden to fix several critical bugs that have been reported by the community. Having trouble collecting the El Generator Artifact? That's been fixed! Camera jumping around in combat? Also taken care of! Want to skip the Splash Screen? That will also be possible!

See below for the full patch notes:

---
[h1]Changelog:[/h1]

[b]CRITICAL FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] El Generator Artifact can be collected even though the Z600 is still 'alive'.
[*] Jumping camera issues for some users should be fixed.
[*] Alt-Tabbing issues should be fixed.
[*]Player duplication bug is fixed. Savegames with this issue are unfortunately non-salvagable.
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Language settings are instantly applied when changed in menu.
[*] Axis keybindings fixed.
[*] Fix for unusable empty save sessions.
[*] Design change - Artifacts are no longer destructible in the forbidden city and house of bones.
[*] Fixes for weapon mod range bonus.
[/list]

[b]MINOR FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Splash Screen Skip now possible when game is fully loaded.
[/list]

notes.title: New patch available. Get it as long as it's warm!
notes.content:
Hi Stalkers,

We have been working very hard to fix as many issues as possible for this patch. However, we are still fighting with the pre-Ryzen AMD processor audio issues – this is what has delayed the release of 1.3. 

We believe that we were able to improve this a great deal in the last patch and were hoping to remove all symptoms with the new patch. Unfortunately the issues are caused by something unrelated to the game itself. We will however continue to chip away at the issue as best we can.

As we want to make sure we get meaningful fixes out to as many of you as possible, we're pushing out the next patch to the main branch. If those of you with pre-Ryzen AMD processors still have issues, you can drop back to the ‘amd_test’ branch (password ‘HKS73903BBSnwee3D’) in the meantime.
We will continue to work through reported issues and very soon we will move on to feedback/suggestions. 

Thanks a lot for your patience and help! We love you guys!
/Mark (TBLC)

1.03

[h1]CRITICAL FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fix for cutscene and inventory freezes on certain Older AMD Processors.
[*] Fix for crash on boot for certain save games.
[*] 'QA Has Suffered' Achievement should now unlock correctly.
[*] Fix for user stuck in combat without enemies in the Castle of Light.
[/list]

[h1]OTHER FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Issues with heroes getting stuck in some covers.
[*] Issue with being able to leave the map in the Metal Fields.
[*] Fixed issues with mind control in Castle of Light.
[*] Fixed stalls when shooting with 'mind-controlled' enemy.
[*] Localized key binding text functional.
[*] Fix for falling through floor of the Rot Warren.
[/list]

[h1]MINOR FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Can now pick up the Smoke grenade in Spear of Heaven.
[*] Destruction and geometry hiding fixes.
[*] Inventory weapon models now update immediately after upgrading them in the ark.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch for pre-Ryzen AMD issues.
notes.content:
Hello stalkers!

We have a fix for most users affected by the pre-Ryzen AMD Inventory and Cutscene freezes.  An interim patch was posted on Friday which seems to fix the issues for 95% of affected users. As this has been well received we shall also patch today for everybody on the 'Default' branch. 

Expect a new patch on Wednesday with more fixes, details to be announced then.

We would suggest that those of you using the 'AMD_test' branch should return to the 'Default' branch when the Wednesday patch goes live.

notes.title: “Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden” Influencer Revenue Share Program
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/c5ef82732b250bbbae32825a33e1066b90d69187.jpg[/img]
Hello Stalkers!

We imagine hunting for scraps and finding artifacts is a full time job but do you also spend time creating content or do you like to stream?

Then this opportunity might wet your appetite:
[b]We are launching the MYZ Influencer Revenue share program![/b]

[h1]How it works[/h1]
Go to [url=https://influencers.mutantyearzero.com/]https://influencers.mutantyearzero.com [u]1[/u][/url] and sign up with either your Twitch, Mixer, Twitter or YouTube account. Once you are logged in with one of the above, you can connect the additional ones.

After you’ve connected all your channels, you’ll see the programs that are available to you according to your followers/subscriber counts on the different channels.

[h1]How to earn revenue[/h1]
Once you click [b]“join program”[/b] you will see a details page. It tells you how much the revenue share is, when the program started and when it ends.

Under [b]“Landing Page”[/b] you will see a Tracking link you can copy. This is your personal influencer link. Add this somewhere prominent on your channel page like in your panel section. It’s also a good idea to add it to your chat area as command or any other location you see fit. Whenever someone buys the game through your link, you’ll get a revenue share from that sale.

[b]Note that the game version in your influencer link is only for the PC/Steam version.[/b]

notes.title: Introducing Farrow
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/a41b0da2157e005cda8e27c35cd2893232549c99.jpg[/img]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-A3OjBMSwDk&feature=youtu.be
[h1]"The odds are against us, yeah. But we're brave, we kick ass, and we don't have heads like moldy muffins!" - Farrow[/h1]
 

She might look like a cute little heartbreaker, but she's no sweet little love maker.  Meet the foxy vixen, Farrow!

Farrow is one of the recruitable characters you'll encounter during your expeditions in The Zone.  When you find her, you may notice that while she's clearly a combat-ready Stalker, she ain't [u]quite [/u]from around here; in fact, she's not even originally from the Ark!

Her true origins are a mystery - even to her.  All she knows is her name's Farrow, and she's a product of the Zone.  She thought her settlement was the only place left in the whole world...

Well, until she met you.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/fBSwd4ahzlGBp4tKT8/giphy.gif[/img]

You'll initially discover Farrow in what people call the Metal Fields; there, you'll be greeted by a mob of Polis-Bots itching to dispense "justice".  Well probably anyway, if robots could feel.  Or itch.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/6515f6d8736af0887c9e416d34e4b1a98e27d045.png[/img]

 
Specializing in stealth and assassination, Farrow comes equipped with skills and gear that make her adept at quickly and quietly dispatching her foes.  Her signature ability, Silent Assassin, doubles her critical strike chance against enemies while she's hidden! This makes her particularly valuable for initiating combat out of stealth, such as when picking off stragglers.

Combine Silent Assassin with items and boosts that further increase crit chance for fantastic results:

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/67eee91af86a13de59fdabcea70aad0489b6216f.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/67eee91af86a13de59fdabcea70aad0489b6216f.jpg[/img][/url]

Other choices allow Farrow to remain hidden while moving between cover, and later she can mutate to possess extreme mobility, able to leap great distances or effortlessly gain high ground advantages.

 
[h1]"Give up now an' I'll go easy on ya!"[/h1]

Let's take a closer look at what Farrow's cookin' with:


[h1][b]FARROW'S MUTATIONS[/b][/h1]
[table]
[tr]
	[th][h1][b]NAME[/b][/h1][/th]
	[th][h1][b]DESCRIPTION[/b][/h1][/th]
	[th][h1][b]ICON[/b][/h1][/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Circuit Breaker[/td]
	[td]You have the ability to instantly identify and disable critical functioning parts of a mechanical enemy. Once shot they will be disabled for 1 turn.[/td]
	[td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/2cba883aa3d6c5a1b542779fa666df46b6567f8e.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Sneak[/td]
	[td]The years of creeping around the Zone have paid off, your cat-like senses have made you supremely aware of your surroundings, giving you the ability to pass by others (mostly) unnoticed.[/td]
	[td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/58888a6ef5989686baec0a4024e5bf37155f3a5f.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Silent Assassin
(Passive)[/td]
	[td]Like the dome-headed assassins of the past, you are able to do great damage whilst hidden from your target. That's as long as you hit... Man.[/td]
	[td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/c3b468655779684b7ef5c6c547be89a93e17b312.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Gunslinger[/td]
	[td]Your hand-to-eye coordination is improved considerably, which gives you the ability to shoot multiple targets at once whilst using only 1 AP.[/td]
	[td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/e3d515a451eb79ad9ac9efd8707d6f7e66f30a58.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Corpse Eater[/td]
	[td]Your metabolism is now abnormally robust, as well as your jaws and teeth. You can eat any type of fresh raw meat to replenish your health. Gross but also strangely satisfying![/td]
	[td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/8ed2d6e9600659bf3cd6827e3c324641f36c6949.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Moth Wings[/td]
	[td]You have the ability to grow wings on your back. This enables you to move vertically and hover in position. Giving you a tactical advantage over enemies beneath you. This also allows you to get to high places which would normally be out of reach.[/td]
	[td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/7514f38dedab8f2728c649b77b7a6af5a5c0eaeb.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Frog legs[/td]
	[td]With your powerful, frog-like leg muscles you can perform super-mutant leaps to cover great distances. Useful if you are cornered by your enemies![/td]
	[td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/235f41354ea0db61d7f7dad489189391a546d22c.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Super Tendons
(Passive)[/td]
	[td]Your leg tendons have become mutated, making them thicker and stronger. You are now able to move or sprint to high places freely and without the use of a ladder.[/td]
	[td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/ae0b5b9441a2ec067854749319c0dc3bf92d2362.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Important gameplay note: You can only equip one Minor (Square), one Major (Hexagon), and one Passive (Circle) mutation at a time!

Now, Let's take a quick look at her passive stat mutations:

[h1][b]STAT BOOSTS[/b][/h1]
[table]
[tr]
	[th][h1][b]NAME[/b][/h1][/th]
	[th][h1][b]DESCRIPTION[/b][/h1][/th]
	[th][h1][b]ICON[/b][/h1][/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Health Booster[/td]
	[td]By beefing-up the physical functions of your body you can permanently increase your maximum health by an additional 1/2/3 HP.[/td]
	[td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/6a4bec5d286849dd54bf38f9795cdac630391ed5.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]Critical Booster[/td]
	[td]Permanently increases the chance of inflicting critical damage by 10/20%.[/td]
	[td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/f314e7135844aa3a9a690d4f30c223716659b1b7.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]


Farrow is the only Stalker capable of increasing their innate critical strike rate. Stat boosts are ALWAYS ACTIVE as long as you've put points into them; you don't have to "equip" the bonuses like you would with other mutations. 

As you can see, Farrow's all about leaving busted heads and broken hearts left in her wake.

How will you utilize Farrow?  We'd love to hear how she fits into your playstyle when [u][b]Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden[/b][/u] launches on [u][b]December 4th.[/b][/u]

Alright Stalkers, that's all for now.  We'll see you in the Zone [u]real[/u] soon.[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32208559/efc0540c59e68ec9259aa86667f72f7ee86e9bc0.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/22O8hNXzqnFdBXqcvw/giphy.gif[/img]
